# Title
Remove Deprecated `verbose` Argument from PyTorch Schedulers

# Explanation
In recent versions of PyTorch (specifically 2.2 and later), the `verbose` parameter in learning rate schedulers (such as `ReduceLROnPlateau`, `StepLR`, etc.) has been deprecated and subsequently removed. Attempting to pass `verbose=True` or `verbose=False` to the scheduler's `__init__` method will raise a `TypeError` because the argument no longer exists in the function signature. To fix this, simply remove the `verbose` argument from the instantiation. If you need to monitor learning rate changes, you should now explicitly log `scheduler.get_last_lr()` or access `optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr']` within your training loop.

# Detection
The issue presents as a `TypeError` during the initialization of the scheduler, typically at the start of training. Look for the following pattern in the traceback:
`TypeError: [SchedulerName].__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'verbose'`
